source_basis.callsite: original run_branch -> run_continuation -> ActualAdvanceChain.__init__ -> inventory and gate.collection_inventory

transformation.cold: Explicit bind(live) source-checks existing live composition, runs original full A/B/transport method inventory once and full collection/generated-template inventory once. Probes are uninitialized exact classes used only by original type/MRO inspection; no constructors, sessions or instance values are read.
transformation.hot: The original constructor code/defaults/kwdefaults/closure and every dynamic guard remain. Private globals change inventory and gate.collection_inventory providers; TRACKED_DRAIN and CapturedRequest are rebound solely to retain the exact new chain type. Both provider calls validate fixed program boundaries, then return fresh proof containers.
transformation.orders: The original ordered A/B/transport inventory is partitioned by its exact label prefixes. Empty, A/B and B/A builtin policy dict orders reconstruct the original insertion order. Other mappings fail closed and are outside this fixed campaign domain.
transformation.identity: Full defining globals are fixed by key/value identity. Function code/defaults/kwdefaults/closure cells, mutable default and attribute containers, classes/MRO/method inventories, exact alias locations, generated template proof and explicit source/proof containers are checked. Exact staticmethod/classmethod underlying Python functions and property Python accessors are additionally captured without invoking descriptors. This extends the boundary; the original inventory only selected ordinary Python functions. Float values use raw IEEE bytes, including distinct NaN payloads. No sys.modules, file reads, source parsing, disassembly or SHA computation occurs in warm providers.
transformation.inverse_proof: No constructor AST edit or compile is performed: original code identity is retained. Full namespace delta is checked against exactly four constructor substitutions, two exact-drain substitutions and the one scheduler class substitution. The original __class__ cell is retained.
transformation.new_request_state: Every root still constructs a new chain, gate, calls list and all dynamic state. Static cache never stores a root, session, policy instance, client, observation, ACK, outbox or decision.

invalidation.fixed_program_change: Raise before serving a cached proof; do not refresh/reseal silently or fall back to an unreviewed implementation.
invalidation.timing: The original dynamic constructor checks precede the original static inventory callsite. This candidate does not claim to sandbox malicious code that changes those earlier guards; closed serial source-pinned execution is required.
invalidation.filesystem: Future campaign still must verify full current/contained archive and actual loaded source identities at entry/exit. In-memory reuse is not a replacement for disk or loaded-closure pins.
invalidation.authority: bind(live) validates source composition only. Real integration must construct live via the unchanged accepted Candidate binder, with the actual module/spec/loader/DLL lifetime checks. Synthetic Python providers in tests establish no C/native authority.

future_cost_gate.requirement: Report cold binding separately and in complete process whole. Compare full original and candidate roots under identical input/policy/budget and retain all dynamic gates, complete evidence and unknown denominator. Warm fixed-dependency checks and proof copying are fully charged. Do not infer a latency gain from removed AST counts or the residual share. Private function cycles remain default-GC and cleanup belongs to complete process whole unless measured otherwise.

synthetic_gate_preparation.owned_scope: All inherited218/current/archive checks, new closure discovery, full canonical all-target preflight, archive, one pytest collection/execution, loaded entry/exit and final exports are inside the single admitted Windows Job worker. No source setup is performed before Job admission.
synthetic_gate_preparation.outer_scope: PowerShell records Python launch through return, plus separately wrapper precheck/export work. Receipt uses CreateNew and all failed artifacts remain. Parent and worker stdout names do not collide.
synthetic_gate_preparation.denominator: pytest_collection_finish records unique nodeids/count from exactly the one new test file before executing tests. XML must contain the same nonzero count with no failures/errors/skips; no hand-entered expected count authorizes pass.
synthetic_gate_preparation.source_archive: Read-only inherited218 plus complete module/test/runner AST closure and wrapper. Absolute input aliases normalize under ROOT and agree byte-for-byte. All archive targets must be independent, contained, nonexistent and shorter than260 before the first archive write. Current source paths are never archive destinations.
synthetic_gate_preparation.historical_raw_or_C_toolchain: None; only source archives and small original campaign metadata are read. No6124 toolchain scan.
